_about: REALM: The Card Game, kept simple. Three champions a side. A champion's HP is 40% of its five stats added up and its Attack is 10%, so rarer beings have more of both. Each turn a side does one thing: attack with one champion, or play one spell. Knock out all three rival champions to win.

blessing._about: A wallet that holds beings and $DMT is blessed, by the same $DMT bands as the holder pool: +3% champion HP and Attack a level, up to +15%.

spells.name: Halo
spells.text: Heal one of your champions for 40.

spells.name: Mandala Ward
spells.text: Your champion blocks the next attack.
